script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune in Pisces, a water sign, forms a trine to Pluto in Capricorn, amplifying your intuitive depth in the 12th House, while Mars squares Venus in your 8th House, stirring intense emotional impulses. Uranus in Taurus forms a sextile to your Midheaven, sparking unexpected career breakthroughs. If you're single, this Neptune‑Pluto harmony draws a dream‑like partner who shares your artistic soul, but watch for idealization clouding judgment. Meanwhile, Mercury sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, turning routine tasks into unexpected windfalls and opening a door to a bold promotion in the 10th, though you must balance ambition with financial discipline. Fixed income streams may rise, yet consider a modest investment to secure long‑term stability. Avoid getting caught in fantasy—by grounding your visions, you'll claim the real reward. Follow for tomorrow's reading and stay ahead of the cosmic currents.
